name: The Star Kite Child
description: A child flying a kite made of glowing constellations, leaving a trail of stardust across a deep blue twilight sky, capturing the essence of childhood wonder.
prompt: A child flying a kite made of glowing constellations and stardust, leaving a bright trail across a deep blue twilight sky, silhouetted against the light, magical atmosphere, highly detailed, nostalgic, emotional, fantasy art, 8k.
caption: Flying a piece of the universe right into the sky. 🌟🪁 What wishes do you think this star-kite carries?
